adjudication.rationale: In `packages/app-store/googlecalendar/lib/CalendarService.ts`, `updateEvent` and `deleteEvent` now compute the target calendar as `externalCalendarId ? externalCalendarId : event.destinationCalendar?.find((cal) => cal.externalId === externalCalendarId)?.externalId;`. When `externalCalendarId` is falsy/undefined, the `find()` predicate compares `cal.externalId === undefined`, which will almost always return no match, yielding `undefined`. This is a regression from the prior behavior that used `event.destinationCalendar?.externalId` (when destinationCalendar was a single object) and will cause updates/deletes to fall back to an unintended default calendar (or pass undefined), matching the finding.
